mapper.select: SELECT id, batch_code, batch_name, batch_status, selection_mode, separate_student_categories, questionnaire_version_id, matching_weight_scheme_id, rule_template_id, hold_duration_seconds, hold_renewal_limit, allow_team, team_min_size, team_max_size, allow_student_random, unselected_strategy, rule_version FROM selection_batch WHERE id = #{batchId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT SUM(scope_type = 'BUILDING') AS building_count, SUM(scope_type = 'ROOM') AS room_count, SUM(scope_type = 'BED') AS bed_count FROM ( SELECT 'BUILDING' AS scope_type FROM batch_building_scope WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} UNION ALL SELECT 'ROOM' FROM batch_room_scope WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} UNION ALL SELECT 'BED' FROM batch_bed_scope WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ) scopes

SELECT resource_message FROM ( SELECT 1 AS resource_order, b.building_code AS sort_building, 0 AS sort_floor, '' AS sort_room, 0 AS sort_bed, CONCAT('楼栋', b.building_name, '(', b.building_code, ')未启用') AS resource_message FROM batch_building_scope scope JOIN dormitory_building b ON b.id = scope.building_id WHERE scope.batch_id = #{batchId} AND b.enabled <> 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2, b.building_code, f.floor_number, r.room_number, 0, CONCAT('房间', b.building_name, '-', r.room_number, '状态为', r.operational_status) FROM batch_room_scope scope JOIN room r ON r.id = scope.room_id JOIN dormitory_floor f ON f.id = r.floor_id JOIN dormitory_building b ON b.id = f.building_id WHERE scope.batch_id = #{batchId} AND (b.enabled <> 1 OR r.operational_status <> 'ENABLED') UNION ALL SELECT 3, b.building_code, f.floor_number, r.room_number, bed.position_index, CONCAT('床位', b.building_name, '-', r.room_number, '-', bed.bed_code, '状态为', bed.operational_status) FROM batch_bed_scope scope JOIN bed ON bed.id = scope.bed_id JOIN room r ON r.id = bed.room_id JOIN dormitory_floor f ON f.id = r.floor_id JOIN dormitory_building b ON b.id = f.building_id WHERE scope.batch_id = #{batchId} AND (b.enabled <> 1 OR r.operational_status <> 'ENABLED' OR bed.operational_status <> 'ENABLED') ) unavailable ORDER BY resource_order, sort_building, sort_floor, sort_room, sort_bed LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO selection_batch (batch_code, batch_name, batch_status, selection_mode, separate_student_categories, questionnaire_version_id, matching_weight_scheme_id, rule_template_id, start_at, end_at, hold_duration_seconds, hold_renewal_limit, allow_team, team_min_size, team_max_size, allow_student_random, unselected_strategy, rule_version, created_by) VALUES (#{batchCode}, #{batchName}, 'DRAFT', #{selectionMode}, #{separateStudentCategories}, #{questionnaireVersionId}, #{matchingWeightSchemeId}, #{ruleTemplateId}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{holdDurationSeconds}, #{holdRenewalLimit}, #{allowTeam}, #{teamMinSize}, #{teamMaxSize}, #{allowStudentRandom}, #{unselectedStrategy}, #{ruleVersion}, #{createdBy})
INSERT INTO batch_building_scope (batch_id, building_id) SELECT #{newBatchId}, building_id FROM batch_building_scope WHERE batch_id = #{sourceBatchId}
INSERT INTO batch_room_scope (batch_id, room_id) SELECT #{newBatchId}, room_id FROM batch_room_scope WHERE batch_id = #{sourceBatchId}
INSERT INTO batch_bed_scope (batch_id, bed_id) SELECT #{newBatchId}, bed_id FROM batch_bed_scope WHERE batch_id = #{sourceBatchId}
